evidence.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')
metrics_path = root/'experiments/stage10/08_meta/SELECTOR_METRICS.csv'
meta_path = root/'experiments/stage10/08_meta/STAGE10_META_ANALYSIS.json'
with metrics_path.open(newline='') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
meta = json.loads(meta_path.read_text())
loopcert_family = ['LoopCert-only','family-balanced blend','risk-calibrated blend','Pareto-front']
selected = {r['selector_name']: {
    'macro_normalized_regret_at3': float(r['macro_normalized_regret_at3']),
    'mean_cost_to_contain_winner': float(r['mean_cost_to_contain_winner']),
    'delta_macro_normalized_regret_at3_vs_cfc_only': float(r['delta_macro_normalized_regret_at3_vs_cfc_only']),
    'delta_mean_cost_to_contain_winner_vs_cfc_only': float(r['delta_mean_cost_to_contain_winner_vs_cfc_only']),
    'beats_cfc_only_on_macro_normalized_regret_at3': r['beats_cfc_only_on_macro_normalized_regret_at3'] == 'True',
    'beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner': r['beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner'] == 'True',
    'top3_containments': int(r['top3_containments']),
    'model_count': int(r['model_count']),
    'panel_rows': int(r['panel_rows'])
} for r in rows if r['selector_name'] in loopcert_family + ['CFC-only','OrbitRepair-Proxy']}
result = {
    'selector_metric_rows': len(rows),
    'gate_results': meta['gate_results'],
    'cfc_baseline': selected['CFC-only'],
    'loopcert_pareto_blend_selectors': {name: selected[name] for name in loopcert_family},
    'all_loopcert_pareto_blend_improve_regret': all(selected[name]['beats_cfc_only_on_macro_normalized_regret_at3'] for name in loopcert_family),
    'all_loopcert_pareto_blend_fail_cost': all(not selected[name]['beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner'] for name in loopcert_family),
    'stage9_proxy_row_for_contrast': selected['OrbitRepair-Proxy'],
}
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
PY
